objective: Write one note proving width Theta(sqrt n) and size 2^Theta(sqrt n) for the knot sphere with every lemma proved: the window criterion, certificates, a segment bound replacing the winding sketch (well-separated cut stars), a planar locality step replacing isoperimetry (vortex kept in a flat region), the density covering, the island lemma, the random packing; and the grid-Sperner corollary with boundary islands. Check the new geometric lemmas computationally and run a final literature search.
status: Proved (COUNT-NOTE-20261107-001A-P001): the sphere's count written out. Every resolution refutation of the octahedral knot sphere needs width >= (k - 6)/1812 and size 2^(c k) (c about 1e-13), every lemma proved: single-step vortex moves (gauge equivalence off two adjacent points), straight cut systems with d >= (dist - 19)/2 (exact local lemma: at most 18 zero-weight junctions), a lattice-row count for one large free component, islands (separation 45), a hard-core random restriction. Grid Sperner and Itsykson et al.'s CSP need width Omega(m) and size 2^Omega(m): three straight arcs make the fixed boundary flat. Final literature check found no general-resolution bound for 2D Sperner.
title: A self-contained proof of the sphere's count bounds
